MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/2
   D. Cannot tell

2. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 3/4

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 34
   C. 22
   D. 17

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 21
   C. 30
   D. 90

5. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

6. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 25

7. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

8. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6

10. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 64
   C. 8
   D. 9

11. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

12. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 7
   C. 18
   D. 6

13. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

14. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

15. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

16. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

17. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 37
   D. 1

18. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

19. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.25

20. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

21. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

22. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

23. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 11
   C. 50
   D. 10

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 14
   C. 22
   D. 28

25. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 30
   C. 18
   D. 45

26. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 36

27. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 31
   C. 41
   D. 43

28. Solve for x: x + 9 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 8
   C. 7
   D. 9

29. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

30. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

33. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

38. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

39. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

40. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
